organization: ISSOL, the International Society for the Study of the Origin of Life
public_contact_or_submission: public Contact Us page linked from the society site
why_relevant: longest-established origins-of-life society (founded 1973), over 500 members in more than 20 countries; runs online seminars and public community channels between meetings
notes: use the public contact route on the society site; do not send to personal addresses of council members

public_contact_or_submission: abstract submission through meeting sites and travel-grant route via the society
why_relevant: triennial ISSOL-IAU Origins meetings are the field's main ground-visible presentation venue; abstracts are submitted through the meeting portal
notes: check the current meeting's abstract deadline before submitting; the 2026 Paris meeting has passed

organization: Origins 2026, ISSOL and IAU Commission F3
public_contact_or_submission: abstract submission via the sciencesconf.org portal
why_relevant: joint ISSOL-IAU meeting, about 350 participants from 26 countries; explicit emphasis on early-career researchers and interdisciplinary origins work
notes: meeting held July 2026; use the portal for the next meeting rather than a closed one

organization: Origins 2029, ISSOL and IAU, Ashoka University
